entries.171216df61b18f02: A single segment, the staffing services business, which operates 5 businesses: the Media & Information Business, Placement Business, New Graduate Media Business, New Graduate Placement Business and IT Dispatch Business. With the corporate philosophy of 'Good work. Good life.', it mainly targets career-oriented 'engineers', 'sales professionals' and 'women'. Revenue for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥18,646 million. It has no affiliated companies and conducts its business on a standalone basis.
entries.621c4c5ed07ad455: A registration-based placement service that operates a paid employment placement business under the name 'type Job Change Agent'. It operates in two areas: a general area covering a broad range of industries and occupations, and a middle area covering specialists and managers. Revenue for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥3,138 million.
entries.73ebe9efeb2379fa: A registration-based new graduate placement business that introduces new graduate hiring opportunities to registered students under the name 'type Shukatsu Agent'. Revenue for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥199 million.
entries.7b000f338db9edde: For new graduates, it publishes the job-information magazine 'type Shukatsu' and holds the job-hunting event 'type Shukatsu'. Revenue for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥787 million.
entries.84b0097b45cfe1a1: It operates a general worker dispatch business under the name 'typeIT Dispatch'. It dispatches registered IT engineers who meet the needs of client companies and operates in 2 forms: fixed-term employment dispatch and permanent employment dispatch. Revenue for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥8,609 million, the largest of the 5 businesses.
entries.bc400f191502853c: Job seekers considering a career change
entries.dbada4176ae0e6b0: A staffing services company that handles job-change websites, recruitment agency services and dispatch of IT engineers, mainly targeting engineers, sales professionals and women.
